idea-plugin.name: Aurora X
idea-plugin.description: A pure-AMOLED dark theme with blue/purple aurora tones for Android Studio and all IntelliJ-based IDEs. True-black #000000 UI + editor background, aurora accent ramp (#86A5FF ice, #C792EA nebula, #89DDFF cyan, #C3E88D green, #F78C6C ember, #FFCB6B gold), and a full editor color scheme covering dozens of languages.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 3.0.0 — Pure-AMOLED rework, expanded UI + editor scheme, multi-editor release.
